authorship: Codex AI-authored with access to scorer implementation and prior examples. Development-exposed, purposefully selected, paired scenarios; not held-out or independently human-labeled.

design.dependence: Two correlated compliant/violating variants per family; neither 120 independent samples nor random population coverage.
design.domains: 60 support and 60 SQL/data-engineering authored traces. These records do not execute tools; actual SQL sandbox verification is separate.
design.measurement: No model calls. Latency/cost are authored boundary arithmetic.
design.semantic_labels: Only packet-level violation labels are compared with whole-packet advisory verdicts; uncertainty remains unscored.
design.human_review: None performed. Reviewer exports are infrastructure, not evidence of participation.
